contracts.initialization: Compose651530 using current sound count, then process ordered tokens. Unknown tokens including group/seq do not alter this handler; separate Group declarations are not included.
contracts.names: Bounded copy keeps at most31 name bytes plusNUL, hashes that stored name, prepends signed-short bucket chain. Filename appends .wav to the mutable token, compares full ASCII names to existing banks, updates reference count and low15-bit bank ID or allocates a63-byte bank name.
contracts.disabled: Disable/comment flags suppress bank allocation and leave low15-bit ID7fff; existing bank names still increment reference count. Missing disabled name allocates only name storage. Its pointer is2948ed0+newNameCount*64; the decompiler typed-array expression obscures this byte stride.
contracts.parameters: Pitch passes signed integer bits; priority clamps-128..127, volume0..16383, fcat0..65535. Pan,pitch/volume randomness, attenuation and four rumble parameters use native finite-float clamps. Tokens remain ordered, so earlier disable/comment changes later fname processing.
contracts.finalization: Clear100000,set200000, memmove full64-byte record to backup, increment global sound count. Token/numeric services modify only prepared parser storage; original scanner and numeric text conversion are outside scope.

native.method: Original6516a0 with original651530, CRC hash, ASCII comparators, append/bounded-copy and final memmove. Only parser next-token/integer/real readers are declared services. Exact token-read sequence and complete prepared sound/global/arena image compare after each sample.
limits: Finite float32 numeric-service returns and terminated ASCII tokens, adequate disjoint sound/bank/name/hash buffers; one sample processed per case, with prepared prior bank/head state.
Shipped1130 sample lines are independently tokenized into explicit inputs; native scanner and numeric text parsing are not claimed. Group declarations and audio backend remain outside this handler.
Existing signed-short bucket heads are preserved; repeated name tokens can create native self-links. This batch does not follow such malformed cyclic chains.
Runtime memory uses virtual addresses in owned byte arrays. Managed replay pending.
